cropRule: all vertices Y >= cutY and |u|,|v| <= halfAt(Y) in shaft axes; halfAt: <85:9.45, <89.5:10.0, <96.6:8.6, else 5.6 m

transform.method: Leveling from area-weighted facade normals (smallest eigenvector), then 2D Umeyama similarity from footprint corners (intersections of robust scan wall-line fits) against the official UT MAI526 GIS rings + campus.json FAC/WCH/GEB rings, seeded by a brute-force roof-mask registration; vertical offset = trimmed mean of baked-terrain minus scan open-ground heights. Author Cesium placement NOT used.

lid.note: measured rim of the open scanned lantern top (matches the authored roof rail top, crown.railTopY); the flat lid is superseded by the authored belfry (roof at crown.roofY)

relight.note: atlas texels unchanged; per-vertex linear multiplier (COLOR_0) swaps the fitted photographed wall sun for the game sun; |normal.y| > 0.8 keeps photographed light

stoneBands.note: captured texels: orthographic resample of plain shaft wall (north/east faces, photographed in shade), divided by band mean; joints drawn at world heights

mast.note: position triangulated from GPS-tagged Commons photos 54984938073 (bearing 321 deg) and 54984752616 (bearing 124 deg), +-0.7 m; lattice drawn as three legs with zig-zag braces; heights estimated

crown.note: authored belfry replacing the scan above cutY inside cutHalf (shaft axes about centreUV); dimensions from the scan half-extent profile cross-checked with photographs; four-fold symmetric (corner piers, 4 columns per face) as seen on all photographed faces; modern roof railing and antenna mast omitted

clocks.note: authored dial discs + gilded bezel bands over the cut scan rings; centre/radius measured from orthographic scan crops; dial drawn from reference photographs (gold bezel, pale blue-green field, dark red radial Roman numerals); hands set to the fixed game-sun time

windowStrips.note: authored detail (near LOD only), registered to the scanned strips; pattern drawn from reference proportions, not photographs
